title: CSS Box Model
description: An interactive MicroSim that helps learners understand how margin, border, padding, and content interact to determine element size and spacing in CSS.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: CSS
Web Development
Box Model
learningObjectives: Identify the four layers of the CSS box model — content, padding, border, and margin — and the order in which they nest outward
Calculate the total width an element occupies as content + (padding x 2) + (border x 2) + (margin x 2), and check the result against the live total
Predict how the total width changes when the padding slider is raised while the content slider is held constant
Explain why an element with width: 100px can occupy far more than 100px of horizontal space on the page
Distinguish padding from margin by their position relative to the border and by the role each plays in spacing
